text: Allow your sexual energy not to have a partner. Your sexual energy is creative life force. If you do not have a partner, do not suppress it and do not consider it unnecessary. On the contrary, gratefully accept the opportunity to explore different levels of arousal and sexual desire. Learn to enjoy them when you cannot “discharge” them by hurrying to have sex—to toss them aside like a hot pie that burns your hands. You will notice that when you do not forbid yourself to enjoy this energy, its remaining with you makes your body more sensual, your psyche more alive, and your life bright.
